title: Hawaiian Teriyaki Chicken

ingredientGroups.title: Marinade
items: 1” of Ginger Root, minced (equal to garlic above)

steps: Combine all marinade ingredients and marinade the chicken overnight or at least 6 hours.
Whisk glaze ingredients together in a pan until smooth.
Bring glaze to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring constantly, until thickened then remove from heat.
Grill chicken over medium-high heat, flipping and glazing with a brush frequently.
Grill for approximately 10–15 minutes, using a thermometer to confirm the chicken reaches 165°F internally.
reviewFlags: The source lists 160°F for removal from the grill. USDA guidance specifies 165°F for poultry.
sourceNote: *** Note: oak and pecan wood smoke impart a great taste for this chicken. Adapted from Trilogy Tours, 2019 Maui Vacation, http://blog.sailtrilogy.com/blog/a-guide-to-trilogys-famous-recipes
